# ============================================================
# APPLICATION SUMMARY
# ============================================================

rt_summary <- get_run_rt_sla(current_run_id)

app_rt_percentile <- 0.95

if (
  exists("rt_sla_config") &&
  !is.null(rt_sla_config$metric)
) {
  app_rt_percentile <- switch(
    tolower(rt_sla_config$metric),
    "p90" = 0.90,
    "p95" = 0.95,
    "p99" = 0.99,
    0.95
  )
}

app_summary <- raw_data %>%
  filter(run_id == current_run_id) %>%
  mutate(
    is_pass = tolower(trimws(as.character(success))) %in%
      c("true", "yes", "1")
  ) %>%
  group_by(app_name) %>%
  summarise(

    transactions = n(),

    errors = sum(
      !is_pass,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    error_rate = round(
      errors /
      transactions * 100,
      2
    ),

    successful_transactions = sum(
      is_pass,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    duration_secs = as.numeric(
      difftime(
        max(timestamp, na.rm = TRUE),
        min(timestamp, na.rm = TRUE),
        units = "secs"
      )
    ),

    throughput = round(
      successful_transactions /
      duration_secs,
      2
    ),

    p95 = round(
      quantile(
        elapsed,
        app_rt_percentile,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      0
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ============================================================
# SCENARIO SLA SUMMARY
# ============================================================

app_scenario_summary <- tibble(
  app_name = character(),
  total_scenarios = numeric(),
  passed_scenarios = numeric(),
  failed_scenarios = numeric()
)

if (!is.null(rt_summary)) {

  app_scenario_summary <- rt_summary$all_labels %>%
    left_join(
      raw_data %>%
        filter(run_id == current_run_id) %>%
        distinct(
          label,
          thread_group,
          app_name
        ),
      by = "label"
    ) %>%
    group_by(
      app_name,
      thread_group
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      scenario_passed = all(passed),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    group_by(app_name) %>%
    summarise(

      total_scenarios = n(),

      passed_scenarios = sum(
        scenario_passed,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

      failed_scenarios = sum(
        !scenario_passed,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

      .groups = "drop"
    )

}

app_rt_breach_summary <- if (!is.null(rt_summary) && !is.null(rt_summary$all_labels)) {
  rt_summary$all_labels %>%
    left_join(
      raw_data %>%
        filter(run_id == current_run_id) %>%
        distinct(
          label,
          app_name
        ),
      by = "label"
    ) %>%
    filter(!passed) %>%
    group_by(app_name) %>%
    summarise(
      breach_count = n(),
      worst_label  = label[which.max(breach_pct)],
      worst_actual = max(actual_rt, na.rm = TRUE),
      worst_sla    = threshold[which.max(breach_pct)],
      .groups = "drop"
    )
} else {
  tibble(
    app_name     = character(),
    breach_count = integer(),
    worst_label  = character(),
    worst_actual = numeric(),
    worst_sla    = numeric()
  )
}

# ============================================================
# SCENARIO LEVEL DETAILS (FOR MODAL DRILLDOWN)
# ============================================================

scenario_health_df <- raw_data %>%
  filter(run_id == current_run_id) %>%
  mutate(
    is_pass = tolower(trimws(as.character(success))) %in%
      c("true", "yes", "1")
  ) %>%
  group_by(app_name, thread_group) %>%
  summarise(
    requests = n(),
    errors = sum(!is_pass, na.rm = TRUE),
    error_rate = round(errors / requests * 100, 2),
    duration_secs = as.numeric(
      difftime(
        max(timestamp, na.rm = TRUE),
        min(timestamp, na.rm = TRUE),
        units = "secs"
      )
    ),
    throughput = ifelse(
      duration_secs > 0,
      round(sum(is_pass, na.rm = TRUE) / duration_secs, 2),
      0
    ),
    p95 = round(
      quantile(
        elapsed,
        app_rt_percentile,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      0
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

if (!is.null(rt_summary) && !is.null(rt_summary$all_labels)) {
  scenario_rt_summary <- rt_summary$all_labels %>%
    left_join(
      raw_data %>%
        filter(run_id == current_run_id) %>%
        distinct(label, thread_group, app_name),
      by = "label"
    ) %>%
    group_by(app_name, thread_group) %>%
    summarise(
      total_labels = n(),
      passed_labels = sum(passed, na.rm = TRUE),
      failed_labels = sum(!passed, na.rm = TRUE),
      scenario_rt_passed = all(passed),
      worst_label = if (any(!passed)) label[which.max(breach_pct)] else "-",
      worst_actual = if (any(!passed)) max(actual_rt, na.rm = TRUE) else 0,
      worst_sla = if (any(!passed)) threshold[which.max(breach_pct)] else 0,
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  scenario_health_df <- scenario_health_df %>%
    left_join(scenario_rt_summary, by = c("app_name", "thread_group"))
} else {
  scenario_health_df <- scenario_health_df %>%
    mutate(
      total_labels = NA_integer_,
      passed_labels = NA_integer_,
      failed_labels = 0,
      scenario_rt_passed = TRUE,
      worst_label = "-",
      worst_actual = 0,
      worst_sla = 0
    )
}

scenario_health_df <- scenario_health_df %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    error_target = get_app_error_threshold(app_name),
    error_passed = error_rate <= error_target,
    scenario_passed = isTRUE(scenario_rt_passed) && isTRUE(error_passed)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ============================================================
# APPLICATION TPS SLA
# ============================================================

app_error_summary <- app_summary %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(

    error_target =
      get_app_error_threshold(app_name),

    error_pass =
      error_rate <= error_target

  ) %>%
  ungroup()

app_tps_summary <- raw_data %>%
  filter(
    run_id == current_run_id
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    is_pass = tolower(
      trimws(as.character(success))
    ) %in% c(
      "true",
      "yes",
      "1"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(app_name) %>%
  summarise(

    successful_transactions =
      sum(is_pass),

    duration_secs = as.numeric(
      difftime(
        max(timestamp),
        min(timestamp),
        units = "secs"
      )
    ),

    throughput = round(
      successful_transactions /
      duration_secs,
      2
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(

    throughput_target =
      get_app_tps_threshold(app_name),

    throughput_pass =
      throughput >= throughput_target

  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ============================================================
# FINAL DATASET
# ============================================================

app_health <- app_summary %>%
  left_join(
    app_scenario_summary,
    by = "app_name"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    app_tps_summary %>%
      select(
        app_name,
        throughput_target,
        throughput_pass
      ),
    by = "app_name"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    app_error_summary %>%
      select(
        app_name,
        error_target,
        error_pass
      ),
    by = "app_name"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    app_rt_breach_summary,
    by = "app_name"
    ) %>%
  mutate(
    scenario_pass = ifelse(
        is.na(failed_scenarios),
        TRUE,
        failed_scenarios == 0
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# APPLICATION STATUS COUNTS
# ============================================================

app_health <- app_health %>%
  mutate(
    application_pass =
      throughput_pass &
      error_pass &
      scenario_pass
  )

applications_total <- nrow(app_health)

applications_passed <- sum(
  app_health$application_pass,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

applications_failed <-
  applications_total - applications_passed

health_summary_html <- sprintf(

  ">

    </span>

      Passing Apps: %s
    </span>

    <span class="status-fail">

    </span>

  </div>
  ',
  
  applications_total,

# STATUS + TOOLTIP

metric_badge <- function(
  value,
  passed,
  suffix = ""
) {

  sprintf(
    "<span class='%s'>%s%s</span>",
    ifelse(
      passed,
      "status-pass",
      "status-fail"
    ),
    value,
    suffix
  )

}

app_health$status_html <- mapply(

  function(
      throughput_pass,
      error_pass,
      scenario_pass,
      throughput,
      throughput_target,
      error_rate,
      error_target,
      failed_scenarios,
      total_scenarios,
      breach_count,
      worst_label,
      worst_actual,
      worst_sla
    ) {

      breach_count <- ifelse(
          is.na(breach_count),
          0,
          breach_count
        )

        worst_label <- ifelse(
          is.na(worst_label),
          "N/A",
          worst_label
        )

        worst_actual <- ifelse(
          is.na(worst_actual),
          0,
          worst_actual
        )

        worst_sla <- ifelse(
          is.na(worst_sla),
          0,
          worst_sla
        )

        failures <- c()

        if (!throughput_pass) {

            failures <- c(
                failures,
                sprintf(
                  paste(
                    "Throughput SLA Failed:",
                    "",
                    "- Actual: %.2f TPS",
                    "- Target: %.2f TPS",
                    sep = "\n"
                    ),
                  throughput,
                  throughput_target
                )
            )

        }

        if (!scenario_pass) {

            failures <- c(
              failures,
              sprintf(
                paste(
                  "Response Time SLA Failed:",
                  "",
                  "- %s of %s User Scenarios failed RT SLA",
                  "",
                  "- %s Transaction Breaches detected",
                  "",
                  "Worst Breach:",
                  "- %s",
                  "- Actual: %s ms",
                  "- SLA: %s ms",
                  sep = "\n"
                ),
                failed_scenarios,
                total_scenarios,
                breach_count,
                worst_label,
                format(round(worst_actual), big.mark = ","),
                format(round(worst_sla), big.mark = ",")
              )
            )

        }

        if (!error_pass) {

            failures <- c(
                failures,
                sprintf(
                  "Error Rate SLA Failed\n\nActual: %.2f%%\nTarget: %.2f%%",
                  error_rate,
                  error_target
                )
            )

        }

        tooltip <- paste(
          failures,
          collapse = "\n\n------------------\n\n"
        )

        if (length(failures) == 0) {

        return(
            "<span class='status-pass'>✅ PASS</span>"
        )

        }

        sprintf(
        "
        <span class='status-fail'>
            ❌ FAIL
        </span>
        <i class='fa fa-info-circle breach-tooltip'
            title='%s'></i>
        ",
        tooltip
        )

    },

    app_health$throughput_pass,
    app_health$error_pass,
    app_health$scenario_pass,
    app_health$throughput,
    app_health$throughput_target,
    app_health$error_rate,
    app_health$error_target,
    app_health$failed_scenarios,
    app_health$total_scenarios,
    app_health$breach_count,
    app_health$worst_label,
    app_health$worst_actual,
    app_health$worst_sla,

    SIMPLIFY = TRUE

)

app_health$scenario_html <- mapply(
  function(passed, total, scenario_pass) {

    if (is.na(passed) || is.na(total)) {
      return("<span class='status-na'>NA</span>")
    }

    metric_badge(
      sprintf("%s of %s", passed, total),
      scenario_pass
    )

  },
  app_health$passed_scenarios,
  app_health$total_scenarios,
  app_health$scenario_pass,
  SIMPLIFY = TRUE
)

render_scenario_table <- function(df, show_app_col = FALSE) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    return("<p style='color:#6c757d; padding:12px 0;'>No scenario details available.</p>")
  }

  rows <- apply(df, 1, function(row) {
    scen_name <- row["thread_group"]
    app <- row["app_name"]
    is_scen_pass <- as.logical(row["scenario_passed"])
    scen_status_badge <- if (is_scen_pass) {
      "<span class='status-pass'>PASS</span>"
    } else {
      "<span class='status-fail'>FAIL</span>"
    }

    req_fmt <- format(as.numeric(row["requests"]), big.mark = ",")
    tps_fmt <- sprintf("%.2f TPS", as.numeric(row["throughput"]))
    p95_val <- as.numeric(row["p95"])
    rt_met <- as.logical(row["scenario_rt_passed"])
    p95_badge <- metric_badge(sprintf("%s ms", format(round(p95_val), big.mark = ",")), rt_met)

    tot_lbl <- as.numeric(row["total_labels"])
    pass_lbl <- as.numeric(row["passed_labels"])
    lbl_text <- if (!is.na(tot_lbl) && tot_lbl > 0) {
      lbl_badge <- metric_badge(sprintf("%d of %d", pass_lbl, tot_lbl), rt_met)
      if (!rt_met && !is.na(row["worst_label"]) && row["worst_label"] != "-") {
        sprintf("%s <i class='fa fa-info-circle breach-tooltip' title='Worst Breach:\n%s\nActual: %s ms | SLA: %s ms'></i>",
                lbl_badge,
                row["worst_label"],
                format(round(as.numeric(row["worst_actual"])), big.mark = ","),
                format(round(as.numeric(row["worst_sla"])), big.mark = ","))
      } else {
        lbl_badge
      }
    } else {
      "<span class='status-na'>N/A</span>"
    }

    err_rate <- as.numeric(row["error_rate"])
    err_met <- as.logical(row["error_passed"])
    err_badge <- metric_badge(sprintf("%.2f%%", err_rate), err_met)

    app_td <- if (show_app_col) sprintf("<td><strong>%s</strong></td>", app) else ""

    sprintf(
      "<tr>%s<td style='font-family:monospace;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;'>%s</td><td style='text-align:center;'>%s</td><td class='numeric-cell'>%s</td><td class='numeric-cell'>%s</td><td class='numeric-cell'>%s</td><td style='text-align:center;'>%s</td><td class='numeric-cell'>%s</td></tr>",
      app_td, scen_name, scen_status_badge, req_fmt, tps_fmt, p95_badge, lbl_text, err_badge
    )
  })

  app_th <- if (show_app_col) "<th>Application</th>" else ""

  sprintf(
    '<table class="scorecard-table" style="margin-top:4px;">
      <thead>
        <tr>
          %s
          <th>Scenario (Thread Group)</th>
          <th style="text-align:center;">Status</th>
          <th class="numeric-header">Requests</th>
          <th class="numeric-header">Avg. Throughput</th>
          <th class="numeric-header">%s</th>
          <th style="text-align:center;">Labels Met RT SLA</th>
          <th class="numeric-header">Error Rate</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        %s
      </tbody>
    </table>',
    app_th,
    rt_column_title,
    paste(rows, collapse = "\n")
  )
}

rows_html <- paste(
  apply(
    app_health,
    1,
    function(r) {
      app_id_safe <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", r["app_name"])
      failed_scen_cnt <- as.numeric(r["failed_scenarios"])
      p95_val <- as.numeric(r["p95"])
      p95_badge <- metric_badge(
        sprintf(
          "%s ms",
          format(
            round(p95_val),
            big.mark = ","
          )
        ),
        is.na(failed_scen_cnt) || failed_scen_cnt == 0
      )

      breach_subtext <- if (!is.na(failed_scen_cnt) && failed_scen_cnt > 0) {
        sprintf(
          "<span class='executive-subtext' style='display:block;padding-left:0;font-size:11px;color:#dc3545;'>%d scenario breach%s</span>",
          failed_scen_cnt,
          if (failed_scen_cnt > 1) "es" else ""
        )
      } else {
        ""
      }

      scen_pass_cnt <- as.numeric(r["passed_scenarios"])
      scen_tot_cnt <- as.numeric(r["total_scenarios"])
      scen_badge <- if (!is.na(scen_tot_cnt) && scen_tot_cnt > 0) {
        scen_all_pass <- is.na(failed_scen_cnt) || failed_scen_cnt == 0
        sprintf(
          "<button type='button' onclick=\"openScenarioModal('%s')\" title='Click to inspect scenario details' style='cursor:pointer; background:#f8f9fa; border:1px solid #dee2e6; border-radius:4px; padding:3px 8px; font-size:11px; font-weight:600;'>%s 🔍</button>",
          app_id_safe,
          metric_badge(sprintf("%d of %d", scen_pass_cnt, scen_tot_cnt), scen_all_pass)
        )
      } else {
        "<span class='status-na'>N/A</span>"
      }

      sprintf(
        "
        <tr style='cursor:pointer;' onclick=\"if(!event.target.closest('button, i, a')) openScenarioModal('%s')\" title='Click to inspect %s scenario details'>

          <td style='font-weight:600;'>%s</td>

          <td>%s</td>

          <td class='numeric-cell'>%s</td>

          <td class='numeric-cell'>%s</td>

          <td class='numeric-cell'>%s%s</td>

          <td class='numeric-cell'>%s</td>

          <td style='text-align:center;'>%s</td>

        </tr>
        ",

        app_id_safe,
        r["app_name"],

        r["app_name"],

        r["status_html"],

        format(as.numeric(r["transactions"]), big.mark = ","),

        metric_badge(
          sprintf(
            "%.2f TPS",
            as.numeric(r["throughput"])
          ),
          as.logical(
            r["throughput_pass"]
          )
        ),

        p95_badge,
        breach_subtext,

        metric_badge(
          sprintf(
            "%.2f",
            as.numeric(r["error_rate"])
          ),
          as.logical(
            r["error_pass"]
          ),
          "%"
        ),

        scen_badge

      )

    }
  ),
  collapse = ""
)

HEALTH SUMMARY

Application Health
Application-level view of performance, showing overall SLA status and key metrics for each application.

Requests
Total transaction requests executed during the test run.

Avg. Throughput
Average successful transactions per second (TPS) achieved during the test.

Response Time
Configured percentile response time (e.g. P90/P95). Shows scenario breach count if any failed.

Error Rate
Percentage of failed transactions compared to total transactions executed.

Scenarios Met RT SLA
Count of user scenarios that satisfied all transaction response time SLAs. Click on any row or button to view detailed per-scenario metrics.
"

      <button type="button" onclick="closeScenarioModal();" style="background:#374151; color:#ffffff; border:none; border-radius:4px; padding:6px 14px; font-size:12px; cursor:pointer; font-weight:600;">Close</button>
    </div>

  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function() {
  window.openScenarioModal = function(appId) {
    var modal = document.getElementById("scenario-modal-backdrop");
    var body = document.getElementById("scenario-modal-body");
    var title = document.getElementById("scenario-modal-title");
    if (!modal || !body) return;

    var targetDiv = document.getElementById("scenario-data-" + appId);
    if (targetDiv) {
      body.innerHTML = targetDiv.innerHTML;
    } else {
      var allDiv = document.getElementById("scenario-data-ALL");
      body.innerHTML = allDiv ? allDiv.innerHTML : "<p>No scenario data available.</p>";
    }

    document.querySelectorAll(".scenario-modal-tab-btn").forEach(function(btn) {
      if (btn.getAttribute("data-app-id") === appId) {
        btn.style.background = "#2563eb";
        btn.style.color = "#ffffff";
        btn.style.borderColor = "#2563eb";
      } else {
        btn.style.background = "#ffffff";
        btn.style.color = "#374151";
        btn.style.borderColor = "#d1d5db";
      }
    });

    if (title) {
      var activeBtn = document.querySelector(".scenario-modal-tab-btn[data-app-id=\'" + appId + "\']");
      var label = activeBtn ? activeBtn.innerText : appId;
      title.innerText = "Scenario Health Details - " + label;
    }

    modal.style.display = "flex";
  };

  window.closeScenarioModal = function() {
    var modal = document.getElementById("scenario-modal-backdrop");
    if (modal) modal.style.display = "none";
  };

  document.addEventListener("keydown", function(e) {
    if (e.key === "Escape") {
      closeScenarioModal();
    }
  });
})();
</script>
'
